evidence.codeTrace: worker.ts:510-549. When Store API doesn't return a product the verify cycle requested (e.g. product went OOS and Store API default filter omits it): line 537-546 explicit comment 'Do NOT increment verifyErrors or deactivate -- just skip'; line 549 'handledProductIds.push(product.id)' marks it as handled. evidence.isThisIntended: YES. This is the 2026-04-03 mass-deactivation incident fix (CLAUDE.md project rule: 'Never deactivate products based on lastSeenAt alone'). Without this guard, Store API's default in-stock-only filter would silently delete every OOS product on every verify pass.
evidence.tradeoff: OOS-to-truly-deleted transitions are invisible to Store API verify -- only Playwright detail-page verify can catch that. Acceptable: stale OOS products will eventually expire via cross-tier cycle completion rules, not via store-api verify alone.
evidence.liveStoreApiPartition: in-stock visible: 2314; out-of-stock visible: 2923. Total Store API addressable: 5237 = WP REST total. Store API does see OOS products IF you set stock_status=outofstock -- but worker.ts:453 does NOT add that filter, so OOS products absent from the include= response trigger the silent-skip branch.
